# Sports Content Playbook

> The content platform for sports social media teams: thousands of real posts from clubs, leagues and brands, why they worked and a weekly content plan.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/): What Sports Content Playbook is and how it works
- [Content Library](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/content-library.html): Real posts from sports clubs, leagues and brands, filtered by sport, platform, format and performance
- [Pricing](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/pricing.html): Plans and prices
- [Blog](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/blog.html): Sports social media trends, content ideas and news
- [Social News](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/news.html): Daily updates from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X and AI explained for sports teams
- [Jobs](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/jobs.html): Job offers in sports digital marketing: social media, content, design, video and partnerships
- [Book a demo](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/book-a-call.html): A 30-minute call with the team
- [Contact](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/contact.html): How to reach us

## Blog

- [From one-off clips to series: the episodic shift in sports social media trends](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/blog/episodic-series-sports-social-media-trends.html): Clubs are starting to publish short video the way TV channels publish shows: in episodes, with characters and a reason to come back. Here is why the Cubs and the Chiefs are betting on series, and how any team can test the format.
- [From schedule drop to tip-off: social media ideas for sports teams from the NBA build-up](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/blog/nba-tip-off-social-media-ideas-for-sports-teams.html): Before the 2026-27 NBA season tips off, teams ran a two-month content build-up. Here is the pattern behind the schedule releases, media day posts and takeovers that stood out, and how to replicate it.
- [Sports Social Media Trends: YouTube Shorts now rewards original content, what it means for sports teams](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/blog/youtube-shorts-original-content-sports-teams.html): YouTube will push original Shorts and cut the reach of channels that re-upload other people's clips. Here is what changes for clubs and how to adapt.
- [City branding: how the Tour de France turns cities into global brands](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/blog/how-the-tour-de-france-turns-cities-into-global-brands.html): Barcelona’s 2026 Tour de France Grand Départ shows how sport can power city branding, business opportunities, and immersive content strategies that extend far beyond the race itself.
- [Social media in sports: how an unknown footballer became one of the World Cup’s biggest stories](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/blog/how-an-unknown-footballer-became-one-of-the-world-cups-biggest-social-media-stories.html): Tim Payne’s rise from 4,000 to 4 million followers shows how authenticity, participation, and community storytelling can create one of the most powerful digital phenomena in sports
- [Gameday Playlist: Powerful Songs for Pre-Match Stories](https://sportscontentplaybook.com/blog/powerful-songs-for-pre-match-stories-free-gameday-playlist.html): Music amplifies emotion and connects instantly. Discover 10 narrative tracks for arrivals, warm-ups, highlights, and routines.
